summary: Provisioning hang: snapper btrfs snapshot rotation blocks home mount after depot SSD replacement
description: Issue summary: After depot SSD replacement and reimaging, affected devices fail to complete the provisioning pipeline. The provisioning agent stalls during the post-imaging user-profile phase when the system attempts to rotate btrfs snapshots via snapper. Impact: Depot staging queue throughput reduced; ~8% of devices hit the stall and require manual intervention (reimage or manual mount). Environment: Depot imaging pod (staging us-west), btrfs root filesystem with snapper-enabled snapshot rotation. Observed behavior: provisioning-agent logs show repeated 'Device busy' and 'failed to remove old snapshot' errors; root mount eventually remounts read-only on a subset of hardware after disk firmware update. Expected behavior: snapper rotates snapshots cleanly and provisioning completes without manual steps.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Replace SSD in depot lab device and apply firmware baseline (firmware v1.4.2).
2) Boot into PXE image and run standard depot imaging task sequence (depot-imaging-2026Q1).
3) Allow SCCM/Provisioning agent to run post-image tasks including snapper cleanup and user profile restore.
4) Observe provisioning-agent at 'post-image: user-profile mount' step; on affected devices the step hangs for >20 minutes and eventually fails with snapshot removal errors.
logs: /var/log/provisioning-agent.log: 2026-03-10T09:12:03Z ERROR snapper: failed to remove snapshot 2026-03-10_09-10: Device or resource busy
kernel dmesg excerpt:  [  241.532112] BTRFS error (device sda1): unable to delete inode 123456: -16 (Device or resource busy)
system journal: provisioning-agent[2145]: Waiting for loop device /dev/loop0 to unmount; stuck on busy loop
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: new SSD firmware changes block discard/TRIM sequences causing btrfs metadata transactions to hang during snapshot cleanup.
Cross-checked similar failures in prod imaging logs — no recent occurrences before firmware v1.4.2 rollout to depot hardware.

Reproduced locally in staging by flashing firmware v1.4.2 to a test Dell 7440: confirmed snapper cleanup intermittently fails when snapper tries to delete oldest snapshot while a background scrub/garbage-collect is running.

Temporary workaround applied at depot: disable automatic snapper rotation step in the provisioning task sequence for affected hardware class; this allows provisioning to continue but leaves snapshot backlog (follow-up required).
Raised a kernel/firmware hypothesis with Platform Eng: linked to btrfs handling of discard on qemu/nvme combo; asked Eng to triage kernel traces and fio workload reproduction.
Attached strace and block traces collected from failed host saved in /mnt/depot-artifacts/INT-434210/
comments: Asha Menon (Reporter) 2026-03-10: Noticed a cluster of staging devices stuck in provisioning today after SSD replacement. Creating ticket to track investigation and depot mitigations.

Depot Tech (Marcus Lee) 2026-03-10: When I hit the hang I manually killed snapper cleanup and mounted the fs; after remounting provisioning continued but user profile restore failed until reimage. Placing affected devices on hold in the queue.
Diego Ruiz (Assignee) 2026-03-11: Reproduced locally; collecting bpftrace/blkparse traces. Disabling snapper rotation as short-term mitigation. Coordinating with platform-eng for kernel trace review.

Platform Eng (Sana Kapoor) 2026-03-12: Requested full kernel oops and blk traces; suspect interaction between firmware v1.4.2 and btrfs qgroup accounting during discard. Will prioritize a repro and patch candidate.
Depot Ops (J. O'Neill) 2026-03-12: Applied change to depot task sequence to skip snapper rotation for devices with firmware >=1.4.2. Tracking manual cleanup backlog as sprint work item.
Diego Ruiz 2026-03-12: Marking this ticket In Progress; follow-up PR and confluence runbook link below once triage complete.
resolution: Mitigation: Depot imaging task sequence updated to skip automatic snapper rotation for affected firmware class (v1.4.2+). Manual snapshot cleanup runbook created for depot techs. Engineering follow-up: platform-eng to reproduce and provide kernel patch or recommended firmware rollback. Post-fix tasks: revert task-sequence change, run a controlled firmware rollout, add an automated check to fail imaging early if snapper queue grows >50 snapshots.
